headline: Robotaxi incentives come due for repayment: Rimac has 5.7 million euros in its account, and must return 81 million to the state - deadline expires
summary: Rimac must return nearly 81 million euros in robotaxi project incentives to the state by the end of 2025. Its financial reports show 5.7 million euros in its account, with ten days left before the deadline.
why: Rimac Automobili is a Croatian electric vehicle and technology company, and repayment obligations can strain its liquidity and funding plans.
